description: Create a UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) checkout session from line items. Returns a UCP checkout object with status 'incomplete'. Starts the UCP flow (ucp_* tools); for the standard flow use create_cart instead. Do not mix the two flows on the same purchase. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED for this write unless sent as the `Idempotency-Key` header or `params._meta["trusteed/idempotency-key"]`. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

intent.description: Intent context for relevance and personalization

label.description: Optional label for additional identifiers (e.g. external order ref, multi-PSP reference)

amount.description: Ignored: the catalogue price is used and returned per line. Any non-negative integer is accepted.

title.description: Ignored: the catalogue title is used. Any non-empty string is accepted.

variant_id.description: Variant (size/colour) id as listed by get_product_details. Required when the product has more than one variant; the price and stock of THAT variant apply.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta['ucp-agent'].profile = URL of the platform profile; it must be an https URL without credentials (at most 2048 characters).

name: ucp_create_checkout
